lines: Captions make a video easier to follow, even with the sound off.
字幕让视频即使静音也容易看懂。
In this tutorial, I'll add captions to a short clip using Shotcut, a free and open-source video editor.
本教程用免费开源剪辑软件 Shotcut 给一段短视频加字幕。
We'll import the clip, add captions, check the timing, move them into place, and export.
步骤：导入、加字幕、检查时间、调整位置、导出。
Click Open File, choose your video, and press Enter. The clip opens in the player.
点击 Open File，选择视频并回车，片段会在播放器中打开。
Click the plus button in the timeline to add the clip to your project.
点击时间线上的加号，把片段加入项目。
Next, click Subtitles in the toolbar to open the Subtitles panel.
然后点击工具栏的 Subtitles，打开字幕面板。
Click the plus button at the top to create a new subtitle track. Name it, set the language to English, and click OK.
点击顶部加号新建字幕轨，命名、语言选英语，点 OK。
Now move the playhead to where the first line starts. Click Add, and type the caption into the Current box.
把播放头移到第一句开始处，点击添加，在 Current 框输入字幕。
To end the caption, move the playhead to the end of the line, and click Set End.
把播放头移到这句结尾，点击 Set End 设置结束点。
Repeat the same steps for the next two lines.
后两句重复同样的步骤。
To show the captions on the video, click the Burn In button. It adds a Subtitle Burn In filter to the output.
点击 Burn In 按钮，会在输出上添加字幕烧录滤镜，字幕就显示在画面上。
Play it back from the start, and check that each caption matches what you hear.
从头播放，检查每条字幕是否和声音对应。
If a caption needs to start earlier, move the playhead, select the caption, and click Set Start.
如果字幕需要提前开始，先移动播放头，再选中字幕，点击 Set Start。
Now let's reposition the captions. In the Filters panel, the Subtitle Burn In filter controls position and style.
接下来调整字幕位置。在滤镜面板里，字幕烧录滤镜控制位置和样式。
I move them up a little by changing the vertical position. Then I make the outline thicker, so the text stays readable.
修改垂直位置把字幕上移一点，再加粗描边，让文字更清晰。
When it looks right, click Export. Keep the Default preset, which makes an H.264 MP4 file, and click Export Video and Audio.
满意后点击 Export，保持 Default 预设（H.264 MP4），点击导出。
Type a file name and press Enter. Shotcut renders the video in the Jobs panel.
输入文件名并回车，Shotcut 在任务面板中渲染。
When the job is done, open the new file to check the result. The captions are now part of the video.
任务完成后打开新文件检查，字幕已经烧进视频里了。
That's the whole process: import, add captions, check the timing, reposition, and export.
完整流程：导入、加字幕、检查时间、调整位置、导出。
Thanks for watching.
感谢观看。
